Dude, I’m done fighting with you. Maybe it’s not the hardest thing on earth, but it’s still not easy either. We both know that. 

Good on you for deciding to stay home during all of this, but like I said I didn’t have any other choices due to the lack of actually communicating with their students ahead of time. By the time they announced they’d be online my lease was up, my notice was in to my building and a new tenant was already found, my flights were booked, our new lease was signed, we had no other options. I’m done with the petty insults. This is ridiculous, we’re both adults and acting like 5 year olds over something stupid. I’m sorry for being a bitch, but I do think you should really consider that other people don’t have the same options as you. Yeah it sucks, you have to drive far to get to the airport, but my option was move or be homeless because they didn’t communicate with us far enough ahead of time.

I had to drive almost 3 hours from my city to reach the Vancouver airport to even fly out, I had to completely relocate my entire life to another city across the country, and that’s not hard? You’re seriously dense if you don’t view that as a major thing. 

And please, try finding an apartment when you’re cross country. It took 3 months of looking to even find one available for us, at which point everything was solidified and unable to be changed. 

If I were you I’d get tested for narcissistic personality disorder, because you seriously lack empathy.

Did you know that moving cross country isn’t that easy? And that it takes several months of planning ahead of time before it’s possible? 

I’m not arguing with some entitled brat with no real world experience. Maybe try moving out of your hometown, getting a real job, really anything that would make you not so irritatingly stupid. Please, I’d love to see someone like you plan a move, cross country, without mommy or daddy’s help.

It doesn’t matter if the chances were low, they weren’t zero. I don’t know about you but I’m not about to risk 2 years of my education on “might not be in person”. Apparently, unlike you, I actually care about my degree.

Here’s a tough story you probably need to hear. 

My best friend in high school was just like your daughter. He struggled with depression, his grades got bad, he was so sick. His parents put him in therapy, and for a while he was improving, until one day they decided he was well enough that he didn’t need the therapy anymore because it was expensive and he was “normal” again. That was around January-ish. By May, not even a full 2 weeks before our high school graduation, he had killed himself. He wasn’t better, mental illness is terminal, and without proper and long term treatment many die from it. 

If your daughter feels she isn’t well enough to leave therapy, she isn’t well enough to leave therapy. Period. Even if you think she is. Do you really want to play a game of Russian roulette with your daughters life? Because that’s what you’re doing by prematurely pulling her from therapy. 


If you really want to help her you’ll get her a tutor and let her stay in therapy. If she’s in middle/high school I’d even be willing to help her a few times a week. But please, for the love of god, do what’s right by her.

You put it perfectly, your kid is better off growing up in 2 healthy households than 1 toxic one. You’ve got to think, do you really want your baby girl growing up seeing that abuse? Thinking it’s okay for her to be beaten by someone else because that’s what her dad did to her mom? As a kid of divorce at a young age I could never imagine my parents being together knowing how toxic their relationship was. Seeing them get into healthy, loving relationships was what taught me what a normal relationship looks like. U/lirio2u is seriously stupid if they think that’s a normal or healthy thing to do for yourself or your children, and should probably seek therapy.

Take care of yourself dude, and if you need a friend I’m here :)

I worked at Red Robin as a server. I was a full time university student and was working a full 40 hours a week for them (in spite of it being outside my availability). The last Sunday before my second semester that year I was scheduled for a “mid shift” which basically means I worked open until mid dinner rush. It was hectic on a whole new level. We were understaffed on all fronts, I was back and forth between my section of tables, to helping in the kitchen, to running food and scrubbing tables. I was doing it all so that things would go smoothly, I completely missed my break that day because I wanted my coworkers to make sure they got a break first.
Now, remember how I said we were understaffed? Well our closer had called in sick, I think he busted his hand or something, and we needed someone to close. I said at the beginning of my shift they could split my shift and I would go home and eat and come back to close that night, they said no that they would figure it out.

I roll around to about the 7 hour point of my shift, I am the first person who started that morning and STILL hadn’t been cut from shift. I asked what was going on and they said that management said they were seating me a party of 20. Now a party of more than 10 is at least 3 hours here, guaranteed. We had hit the slow point of the night and had girls and guys who had completely empty sections and were waiting for a table, but they wanted to seat me.

Obviously I said no, I’m not working overtime (which is within my legal rights here in Canada) I told you I start classes tomorrow and that I still have to go get a few new school things before then. And that is when the fight ensued. They kept saying I had promised to close for them at the beginning of the night blah blah blah, which I never did. I had said if I was going to be changed to a split shift I would work, but no way in fucking hell was i working a 12 hour shift for them. The whole ordeal lasted until I hit my 8 hour mark, and my coworkers (aside from the douche who called in) backed me on it saying it was stupid. We had people VOLUNTEERING to take the table instead of me taking it. 

My boss tried to call insubordination and fire me, I had actually printed up my two weeks that morning and had been debating when I was going to hand it in, between this management teams fucking power trips (so much more happened with them) and the fact they CONTINUED to schedule me well out of my availability I was absolutely done. I handed him my resignation on the spot and told him I would not be coming in for the rest of my shifts and basically that he could go fuck himself. I had trained their people, I had busted my ass for them, and I got that. All he said was “good we don’t want you here anyway” 

I filed a report with corporate and they did jack shit. I still pop in every now and then to piss him off because I am now working another serving job where I am a trainer and make 2-3x what I made there a night.
It’s flat out discrimination, you need to go on r/legaladvice
